scope: Actual saved Daily/7 days ready/missing chart captures at 100/150/200 percent, normal production fonts
observations: Chart headers, two legends, UTC axes, controls and source-state text remain visible and separate from the tables.
Daily scene has connected adjacent observations and isolated markers; unknown hours leave gaps.
Seven-day scene preserves missing/empty gaps and observed zero/signed values; range includes negative corrections and no weekly sum.
All-missing daily/seven-day scenes show no data trace and an explicit empty message.
Chart height leaves the existing seven-day rows visible and retains scrolling for the hourly table.
New charts use bytes and distinct solid blue/dashed orange traces; actual preview uses normal text rendering rather than the raster-test font fixture.
limitations: Offscreen captured windows only; manual compositor/font/locale acceptance remains separate.
Inherited table columns remain interactively resizable.
